facts.fact: 董事会比预期顺利：几名公开敌对、更代表美国政府利益的董事对他的最新 A/B test 进展不满（一贯如此），但 Fisch 凭魅力与机智挡下质询，保住了董事会多数。
facts.anchor: Sure, a few of the more openly adversarial figures—those who represented the US government’s interests more than Fisch’s own—weren’t pleased with the progress of his latest A/B test. They’d never been.

facts.fact: 董事会进行中 Shailene 敲门打断发言、耳语禀报 Bethany Peters 本人在楼里；Fisch 没有失态，低声回令让 Bethany 进来复工——Bethany 在这里只会加速她的「进程」。
facts.anchor: Then Shailene had knocked on the conference room door, interrupted him mid-sentence, and whispered in his ear that Bethany Peters herself was in the building. He hadn’t lost his cool, had whispered orders right back to his head of security, telling Shailene to let Bethany in, to let her get back to work.

facts.fact: 乘司机 Charlie 的车回 Austin 城外牧场的路上，Fisch 终于向自己承认：促使他与 Bethany 搭话失慎的真正原因是愧疚（guilt）。
facts.anchor: On the ride back to his ranch outside Austin, as his driver Charlie whisked him home, Fisch finally admitted to himself what had actually inspired his carelessness. Guilt.

facts.fact: Shailene 的最新报告显示：Bethany 已瞥见录像店，预计十二至二十四小时（twelve and twenty-four hours）内安全入店并完成穿越；之后 Fisch 将给团队下达把 A/B test 结果全站（sitewide）部署的指令。
facts.anchor: Shailene’s latest reports indicated that Bethany had already glimpsed the video store, would be safely inside it and fully crossed over in anywhere between twelve and twenty-four hours.

facts.fact: 晚间换衣时怪兽 Chimotera 扑进卧室把 Fisch 扑倒，一爪剖开他的腹部、掏出肠子与内脏；Fisch 强忍不叫、对它喊「Buddy！这是发作」，随后伤口退回幻想、他毫发无伤。
facts.anchor: As the monster sliced his claw right down Fisch’s middle, then wasted no time digging out the intestines and vital organs he found inside. It hurt like death, but Fisch forced himself to maintain his composure.

facts.fact: Fisch 是 GlobalVill「Screen Share」计划的开创者：他在自家家庭影院里借 Chimotera 系列电影入定、进入两个现实之间的会面点——早年要独自在黑暗中反复看同一部电影一整天，如今通常在第一幕结束前就能入定。
facts.anchor: Back when he first pioneered the Screen Share program at GlobalVill, getting into this state used to take him full days alone in the dark watching the same movie on repeat over and over again. Now he was such a pro at it that he could usually dip into that meeting ground between realities before the end of act one.

facts.fact: Fisch 判断这种发作不正常——此前只发生过一次，是多年前的 Erin Morrison 事件；他最终问怪兽是否见过「the receiver」，并从 Chimotera 的表情确认自己最坏的担心成真。
facts.anchor: “Did you see the person we talked about once?” he asked the monster finally. “Did you see the receiver?”

facts.fact: 电话转给侄子 Kyle 后，Fisch 下令：Bethany Peters 必须被立即清除——死掉、入土、永远无法抵达 Public Access Afterworld；与「男友」案同一批的毒药已送往 Kyle 公寓，Kyle 只需换装回到角色、给 Bethany 打电话（Shailene 的人十分钟后到他家布置一切）。
facts.anchor: Bethany Peters needed to be removed immediately. Dead, in the ground, where she couldn’t ever reach Public Access Afterworld.
